nodes.name: Houses & Lodging
nodes.offers: Build Houses and a Lodging; every bed beyond the 4 founders lets one more settler live here.
details: House (up to 4 beds) and Lodging (up to 8 beds) plans
Population = beds (minimum 4 founders)

Every House plaque names its home tier: Hut (level 1), Cottage (level 2, with Cottages), Townhouse (level 3, with Townhouses) or Manor (level 4, with Manors), with the next tier's goal and a 'next level: add X' checklist. Tiers come from what is built in the room, never from a blueprint
Well House plan: while a valid Well House stands, every settler with a bed gets +2 morale
nodes.flavor: Four walls, a door and a fire: now it is home.

nodes.name: Banner Fires
nodes.offers: Warm homes keep hunger down at night, and an evening by the Banner fire lifts everyone's spirits.
details: Night-time hunger drain -10%
Idle settlers walk to the Banner fire more often (+20% chance)
In the evening, a settler warming at the fire gains +3 morale (a heart shows), once per day
nodes.flavor: A banked fire, a full belly and someone to talk to.

nodes.name: Tavern & Inn
nodes.offers: Build a Tavern; an Innkeeper serves meals and ale and draws recruits.
details: Tavern plan (a bell, which can be copper) + Innkeeper emblem: meals, ale, recruitment and the evening bard
Market plan: while a valid Market stands, visiting merchants carry 6 more Coins
Recruits cost 25% less with an Innkeeper
First step of the Tavern ladder: Bard's Stage, then Rooms to Let, then Hall of Revels
nodes.flavor: Every road ends at a tavern door.

nodes.name: Cottages
nodes.offers: Better beds: settlers with a claimed bed get +2 morale, and +2 more in a well-kept home.
details: Residents with a claimed bed: +2 morale
Residents of a level-2 House or Lodging: +2 more morale. The plaque lists what the next level needs (more lights, a chest, a solid floor)
A level-2 House is named a Cottage on its plaque
nodes.flavor: Straw is for horses. Flowers are for the sill.
depends_on: Home-tier checklist on HOUSE (Requirement tiers + plaque 'next level' line)

nodes.name: Feather Quilts
nodes.offers: Settlers who sleep a calm night in a bed wake Well Rested and can do 10% more work that day.
details: Sleep energy regain +20%
Well Rested: waking from a night in a bed refills the daily work pool to 110% (green sparkles on waking)
Not while the village is alarmed or a raid threatens, so a night raid costs you the bonus
nodes.flavor: Goose down: a lord's luxury, now a peasant's right.

nodes.gate_text: Everyone housed for 1 day + 5 equipment requests served (existing gate)
nodes.name: Scholar's Study & Library
nodes.offers: A Scholar researches upgrades you choose, a Library makes every project cheaper, and study goes faster.
details: Architect's Study plan + Scholar emblem
Library plan (moved here): research goods -25%
Every tech tree study timer (Town, Castle and Kingdom nodes) runs 25% faster
nodes.flavor: Ink is cheaper than blood.

nodes.name: Bard's Stage
nodes.offers: The bard plays to a crowd: evening morale lifts higher, and visiting travellers tip Coins.
details: Evening bard morale lift 5 -> 8 (once per settler per day, with a meal or ale at the Tavern while the bard plays)
Travellers (never your own settlers) who eat or drink while the bard plays tip 1 of their Coins into the Banner or a Warehouse, at most 3 per Tavern per evening
nodes.flavor: A song for the living, a song for the dead, and one more for the road.

nodes.name: Kitchen & Long Table
nodes.offers: Build a Kitchen and a Dining Hall, and hire a Cook to feed the village.
details: Kitchen and Dining Hall plans + Cook emblem
Dining Hall: recruit price -25% (with the Innkeeper, the cap is -50%)
Villages that owned the old Hall and Learning keep these plans
nodes.flavor: Everyone eats at the long table, and everyone has an opinion about the stew.

nodes.name: War Feast
nodes.offers: When a raid is warned and the stores hold 12 meals and 4 ale, the village feasts: guards fight 10% harder and hold their nerve that night.
details: Automatic at the raid warning: 12 meals + 4 ale are taken from the Banner and Warehouses (all or nothing) and a war horn sounds
Until the dawn after the raid: guards and soldiers deal +10% damage
Feasted guards only fall back to eat below 15% health (normally 30%)
Short of food? A message tells you what is missing
nodes.flavor: Eat, drink, and let them hear us singing from the treeline.
depends_on: Feast gathering event at the Banner
Courage flag for guards and civilians

nodes.name: Townhouses
nodes.offers: Townhouses: every House may hold two more settlers (bed cap 4 -> 6), and a House furnished to level 3 is a Townhouse.
details: House bed cap 4 -> 6: up to 6 beds per House count for housing and recruitment
Without it, beds beyond the 4th in a House stay empty (nobody already living there is moved out)
Lodgings are unchanged (all their beds count)
A level-3 House is named a Townhouse on its plaque
nodes.flavor: Build up, not out, and put a window box on every sill.
depends_on: Traveller skill roll by home tier

nodes.name: Wayside Chapel
nodes.offers: A small chapel: after every raid you hold, the village gives thanks and everyone's morale lifts.
details: After every raid held: +5 morale for everyone, and the bells ring
Pick one: Chapel or Alehouse. The Chapel path leads to the Cathedral
nodes.flavor: Leave a coin, say a name, and the road is kinder.
depends_on: Roguelike Blessings expansion (today 3 blessings: Warden's Oath, Hearthward, Thorned Roads)

nodes.name: Alehouse
nodes.offers: A proper alehouse: build a Brewery, hire a Brewer, and a pint lifts spirits more than ever.
details: Brewery plan + Brewer emblem
A pint at the Tavern: morale 3 -> 5
Pick one: Chapel or Alehouse. The Alehouse path leads to the Hall of Revels
nodes.flavor: Brewed on Tuesday, gone by Thursday.

nodes.name: Infirmary
nodes.offers: Build an Infirmary: wounded settlers inside heal steadily.
details: Infirmary plan
Wounded settlers inside a valid Infirmary heal 1 HP every 2 seconds (hearts show)
Healers are hired with Battle Healers
nodes.flavor: Boil the water, and fetch the priest only if I say so.

nodes.name: Manors
nodes.offers: Manors: every House may hold two more settlers again, and a House furnished to level 4 becomes a Manor whose residents are happier.
details: House bed cap 6 -> 8
Manor = House level 4: 5 lights, 2 storage, a solid floor, furnishing 6, a workbench and 25 floor space
Residents of a Manor or of a level-3 Lodging: +2 more morale
nodes.flavor: The oak panelling came from the lord's own forest.
depends_on: Traveller skill roll by home tier

nodes.name: Rooms to Let
nodes.offers: Your Tavern becomes a famous inn: minstrels and trade caravans visit twice as often.
details: On an event day, the Minstrels and the trade Caravan are twice as likely to come
nodes.flavor: The best beds between here and the capital, and the loudest common room.

nodes.name: Harvest & Midsummer Festivals
nodes.offers: Every 4 days at dawn the village holds a Harvest Feast: +15 morale and faster workshops for a day.
details: Automatic at dawn every 4 days when the Banner and Warehouses hold 48 bread + 16 ale (all or nothing)
Everyone gains +15 morale
Until the next dawn every workshop crafts 10% faster
Short of food? A message says what is missing, and the feast tries again next dawn
nodes.flavor: Tables in the square, pipes in the lane, and nobody works till noon.

nodes.name: Hall of Heroes
nodes.offers: Honour the fallen: the village grieves half as much, and newcomers arrive in better spirits.
details: Morale lost when a settler dies (-15) is halved
New recruits arrive with +5 morale
nodes.flavor: Read their names aloud. Then pick up your spear.

nodes.name: Families & School
nodes.offers: School: new settlers arrive already trained, one level ahead in every trade.
details: New recruits start at trade level 2 in every trade (instead of level 1)
School plan: while a valid School stands, new recruits start at trade level 3
Library plan (also with the Hearth Doctrine)
nodes.flavor: Her father was a smith. She will be a better one.

nodes.name: Cathedral
nodes.offers: A cathedral rises over the town: after every raid you hold, the whole village's morale soars.
details: After every raid held: +10 morale for everyone, on top of the Chapel's +5
Pick one: Cathedral (Chapel path) or Hall of Revels (Alehouse path)
nodes.flavor: Bells for the living, candles for the fallen.

nodes.name: Hall of Revels
nodes.offers: The greatest hall in the land: the house matches every Coin travellers pay for meals, and the bard lifts spirits twice as high.
details: Every Coin a traveller pays for a Tavern meal earns 1 more Coin into the Banner or a Warehouse
The bard's evening morale lift is doubled (8 -> 16 with the Songbook)
Pick one: Hall of Revels (Alehouse path) or Cathedral (Chapel path)
nodes.flavor: Ale, song, and a joust at noon.

nodes.name: Fishery
nodes.offers: Build a Fishery; a Fisher lands food from day one, and rare catches for trade.
details: Fishery plan + Fisher emblem (2 Coins, 2 string)
Rare fish (perch, trout, pike, golden char) sell to merchants
Carry the catch home yourself until a Warehouse and a Courier exist
nodes.flavor: The river pays in silver scales.

nodes.name: Fields & Farmer
nodes.offers: Build a Farmhouse and hire a Farmer who sows, reaps and stores wheat.
details: Farmhouse plan + Farmer emblem (2 Coins, 8 seeds, 1 leather)
Crop Rotation research: +15% crop growth
nodes.flavor: Bread starts in the mud.
